text:
zoe: quick FYI — hitting a weird debugging friction in node SDK: when we get 429 + retry, the logs show request_id empty. repro below, short stack/steps.

kai: can you paste the minimal repro?

zoe: repro: send a request that triggers rate limit; SDK retries automatically but the X-Request-Id header isn't preserved. sample:

```js
await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-lambda',
  prompt: 'test',
  headers: { 'x-request-id': uuid() }
});
```

logs show:

```
INFO request started method=generate req_id=""
WARN retry attempt=1 original_req_id="" status=429
```

ben: that sounds like our retry middleware creates a fresh request object and forgets to copy metadata. also OTEL retry hooks may be re-starting spans without the original attributes.

rachel: also seeing mismatched log levels in the sample-app: debug logs from sdk are surfaced at INFO because LOG_LEVEL mapping isn't applied in our default logger init.

kai: plausible fix: ensure retry logic copies over incoming headers/ctx and preserve request-id in retry metadata. also, have OTEL instrumentation attach request_id to span attributes on span start so logs correlated via hook.

zoe: adding a redaction concern — some logs currently dump full prompt text during error cases. we need a redaction hook that masks prompts before they hit structured logs or OTEL events.

ben: proposed redaction middleware (pseudo):

```js
client.addMiddleware(async (req, next) => {
  if (req.body?.prompt) req.body.prompt = redact(req.body.prompt);
  return next(req);
});

function redact(s) { return s.replace(/\S/g, '*').slice(0, 100); }
```

rachel: I'll open a PR that:
- copies headers in retry path
- attaches x-request-id to span attrs
- fixes LOG_LEVEL mapping in sample-app init
- adds a configurable redaction hook with default safe policy

kai: test plan: unit tests for header propagation, e2e with local rate-limiter to assert req_id persists, and smoke with OTEL logs showing span.attr.request_id == header.

telemetry-bot: created issue #2184: "node-sdk: preserve request-id on retry + add redaction hook" <https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/2184>

ci-bot: CI for branch 'fix/retry-reqid' passed :white_check_mark:

zoe: awesome — rachel please tag me on the PR. once merged we should ship to staging and enable the redaction opt-out flag for internal orgs only.

rachel: will do. tagging @kai @ben. thanks :shipit:

kai: small note — let's ensure the python SDK has parity; I'll file a mirror issue after this.

ben: ack, adding a checklist to the issue for python + go clients.

zoe: cool, thanks all. this should remove a lot of the onboarding noise where early users see blank req_ids and can't trace errors.
